notes.title: 1.2 Preview - Available now!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]great news for those waiting for 1.2. Here comes the preview. We aim for a full release right when Autumn Steam Sale begins (so not too far off from now).[/p][p]To access the preview version, you need to switch the branch to "Preview".[/p][p]Few important details:[/p][list][*][p]The preview uses separate saves from the main game - if you want to use your existing save, you need to copy and rename it to "GameSaveBeta0.es3"[/p][/*][*][p]All players need to be on the preview branch to play online (one can't be on the main branch, the other on the preview branch)[/p][/*][*][p]Many translations are missing aside from English. Those will be added with the full release of 1.2[/p][/*][/list][p]Here is the whole changelog:[/p][list][*][p]10 new achievements[/p][/*][*][p]New map: Rural Arizona[/p][/*][*][p]New hazard: motion sensor. Works similiar to a camera, but it is used indoors[/p][/*][*][p]Due to the new map and loot, debt in hardcore mode was increased from 50k to 100k[/p][/*][*][p]3 stealable cars[/p][/*][*][p]Many new item requests[/p][/*][*][p]'Win game once' furniture is unlocked in completionist mode from the start[/p][/*][*][p]Radar doesn't spawn icons for loot inside the truck[/p][/*][*][p]Patrolling policeman was slightly degraded (runs slower and has less stamina)[/p][/*][*][p]Better loot in Texas train station heist[/p][/*][*][p]Added measures to prevent leaderboard cheating when using mods / someone else's save[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed police running to nearest player's position (even if he's not seen) after a failed chase[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced 'police jammer' level requirement from 20 to 10[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs won't chase you too far from their residence[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs run slower when they're out of stamina[/p][/*][*][p]Increased time between NPC taser shots[/p][/*][*][p]Heist day cooldown is not started before returning to the hideout[/p][/*][*][p]Increased chances for skill leaflets / golden card spawns on certain difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Added quota finalize warning if there are still days left[/p][/*][*][p]Added cameras keypad to 212[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocked keybind settings for minigame left / right buttons[/p][/*][/list][p]If you find bugs, don't hesitate to report them in 'Bug Reports', on Steam discussions. Enjoy ːsteamhappyː[/p]

notes.title: 1.19h - Fixed multiplayer, new content
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]since morning I've been trying to fix the authentication bug and it seems to be gone with this update. Sorry about the problem.[/p][p]Along with that, there's some new content and fixes.[/p][h3][/h3][p][b]1.19h:[/b][/p][p]- Tied up NPCs have an indicator showing how much time is left before they break free[/p][p]- You can flag up to 3 objects on the radar, instead of one[/p][p]- You can unflag radar objects by pressing right mouse buton[/p][p]- New item requests category: Vehicle parts[/p][p]- New furniture piece: Magic lever. Moves loot from the truck to the delivery box in the hideout[/p][p]- New furniture piece: Police jammer. NPCs take longer to call for help, police takes longer to arrive[/p][p]- New object: Electronic safe. Requires a code, can be broken into if you have a certain skill[/p][p]- You can interrogate tied up NPCs and find out keypad codes, where traps are etc. (after learing a certain skill)[/p][p]- If you have over 120 health, you don't go down instantly after being tased[/p][p]- Fixed bug when the 'package to plant' would be marked as an item to steal in the timed job[/p][p]- Fixed the undestroyable 103 and 211 bathroom door[/p][p]- Alarm is triggered when a door with alarm is destroyed[/p][p]- Fixed dark screen upon loading and pausing the game[/p][p]- Fixed sidewalk collider issue near 204[/p][p]- NPCs collision is disabled if you kill them[/p][p]- Added door key to 103[/p][p]- Improved input mapping with a controller[/p][p]- Added max distance to alarms in keypads etc. NPCs beyond that range won't hear them[/p][p]- Stolen keys are saved on Endless mode (previously they respawned all the time)[/p][p]- New morning ambience in the hideout[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Interrogating NPCs, new minigames
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]I'm still hard at work on the 1.2 update and I wanna share some new mechanics with you. There are some really interesting ones.[/p][p][/p][h3]Interrogation[/h3][p]Once you’ve tied someone up, you’ll be able to [b]interrogate them[/b] to uncover safe and keypad codes, locate traps, and more. This requires a brand-new skill, so plan your builds carefully if you want to make the most of it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/93d8278c479ffc2fd23f8cfb13c5050e1eedcd47.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Electronic safe & new hotwiring minigame[/h3][p]A brand-new [b]electronic safe[/b] has been added to the game. You can open it in one of two ways:[/p][list][*][p]Learn the code through interrogation[/p][/*][*][p]Or crack it yourself with a [b]Level 2 Electronics skill[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/2dd854e88bb5cf73513814de9192e13e740badac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The hotwiring minigame has also received an overhaul - more engaging, and inspired by the [i]TS2[/i] minigame.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/fbcca97b503daee7e3bc31c2b7b428e5f2080d37.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Radar improvement[/h3][p]Previously, you could only flag one item on the radar. Now, you can flag up to 3 objects, and unflag them with the right click.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/8825b24b39a348e67b5d1081613adb40e43128a6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Magic lever and police jammer[/h3][p]Two new furniture items are making their debut:[/p][list][*][p][b]Magic Lever[/b] - Instantly transports loot from your truck straight to the delivery box in your hideout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Police Jammer[/b] - Slows down police calls and delays their arrival, buying you more time.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/744824d96f7c3ba6773e98a08cbed260e7eb80cf.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]New map sneak peek[/h3][p]I'm focusing on the new map now. Here's a small showcase.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/caf219311a600e4b5a82bb57e02501ded9cbd576.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Other Notable Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tied-up NPCs now have a visible timer before they break free.[/p][/*][*][p][b]10 new achievements[/b] to unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]If your health is above 120, you won’t be instantly taken down by a taser.[/p][/*][/list][p]Stay tuned for more. ːsteamthisː[/p]

notes.title: 1.2 Sneak peek: Stealing cars
notes.notes: [p]Hi, don't worry, game is not dead, in fact it's in a better shape than ever.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now I’m working on car theft, and it’s about 90% done. Just need to add more vehicles to steal. Planning to throw in 2-3 cars on the current maps, and more on the new one.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a little sneak peek of how it works: some cars will have alarms you’ll need to deal with first - unless you don’t mind everyone hearing the mess you’re making.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/656c712a2a18192a52354db2ae1251982c7cb2c3.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/91b4c16e33837dcda8f431074411a4fb2768e646.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/428787939c1e676114f53c963988c142c9fa36dc.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/82b923aad8628dd55dc03798aa5df3c1f33ade14.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Aside from cars, 1.2 will feature a new map, more achievements and other stuff, so stay tuned. ːsteamthisː[/p]

notes.title: Roadmap Reveal + Community Vote for Next Features
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing Crime Simulator and providing a lot of useful feedback! For almost last 4 weeks, I tried to push as many updates as I could to make the game better for you![/p][p]As promised, I will continue development at full speed, with new content and features already underway.  Today, I am sharing the official roadmap - and opening the door for players to help decide what comes next. [/p][p][/p][h2]Roadmap[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/6004959dcac3bfbc85342de8e2e8d9bdef6fa265.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]Update 1.2[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New desert map[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New golden cards[/p][/*][*][p]New achievements [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Update 1.3 – Jewels Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Steal treasures and rare gems[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]Insert jewels into items to boost their value    [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/5eeff4f9603f7c6d0e304b1b4001cb4a233e991c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Next? You Decide.[/h2][p]Several upcoming features are not yet locked in - I want players to pick the next features! In the below survey, you can vote for new mechanics, item types, or even suggest new Golden Cards! [/p][list][*][p][b]Hideout System:[/b] Buy a mansion and use it as a personal base [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Car Theft Mechanics:[/b] Disable alarms, sneak into garages, and steal high-value vehicles [i](Note: Car theft would require the hideout system to be in place)[/i]    [/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forms.gle/H5ZheJfdSLwVKYot8" style="button"]Vote Here | Pick New Features, Items & Golden Cards[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Looking Ahead: Possible DLC Concepts[/h2][p]After several free updates, the following DLC ideas may be considered, depending on your (player) feedback:[/p][list][*][p][b]High-Tech District:[/b] A modern map with luxurious mansions and advanced security.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heist Pack:[/b] Three large-scale heist missions with unique challenges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Siberian Town:[/b] A snowy, isolated area with new loot, new hazards, and its own style.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] Player feedback has shaped the game since the beginning. We want to keep it that way. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Stay Low (but follow the game xD)![/b][/p]

notes.title: 1.19e - Run without stamina, radar QoL and more
notes.notes: [p]First of all, I want to thank everyone who is playing and enjoying the game - without you, I wouldn't be able to keep going. The game is not everyone's cup of tea and that's fine, but I'm still very happy so many people are enjoying it.[/p][p][/p][p]This game has sold more copies than I'd ever hope for and I'm really grateful for that. I've put a lot of work into this, many sleepless nights, and I will continue to do so, so you can have the best experience.[/p][p][/p][p]I will share a roadmap soon, but for now, here's a nice update which makes things more manageable and fun.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1.19e:[/b][/p][p]- You can keep running with no stamina, but you're slower[/p][p]- You can click on radar icons to spawn a marker on them[/p][p]- Added 'military receiver' tutorial to pause menu tutorials[/p][p]- 'Police' golden card now reduces the amount of places policemen search[/p][p]- Fixed banana[/p][p]- Police drone is louder[/p][p]- Safe unlocking minigame was made easier (with or without stethoscope)[/p][p]- Stethoscope is cheaper[/p][p]- Increased night time slightly[/p][p]- Scanner UI improvements[/p][p]- Fixed items falling into the chest[/p][p]- Repair ability can be used in the hideout[/p][p]- Base weapon throw force increased[/p][p]- Decreased stamina drain while jumping / fence climbing[/p][p]- Minor optimizations[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.04: Improved difficulty, player count setting and more
notes.notes: [p][b]🔧 Update 1.04[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone — thanks so much for playing Crime Simulator, and for all the feedback you've been sharing. I’ve been going through everything and wanted to get some early improvements out based on what I’ve seen and heard:[/p][list][*][p]Made overall difficulty a bit more forgiving[/p][/*][*][p]Basic lockpicking is now easier[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to limit max players in co-op (main menu)[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs cool down faster (anger meter drops quicker)[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina now regenerates faster[/p][/*][*][p]“Return to hideout” timer in the morning increased from 30 to 60 seconds[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/1a301fa57bae9ba2d9905ad8c18bb29aea1da500.png"][/img][/p][p]👋 [b]A quick note from dev[/b][/p][p]I just want to say — I hear you. I'm reading all the reviews and comments, and while some of the criticism stings (especially after pouring everything into this), I know it's coming from a place of wanting the game to be better. And that's exactly what I'm working on.[/p][p]This project has been a huge challenge to pull off solo, but I’m not giving up. Every bit of feedback helps, and updates like this are just the beginning.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with me — more to come soon.[/p]

notes.title: Playtest summary
notes.notes:
Hi, I want to thank everyone who participated in the playtest. We managed a nice peak of 734 people. I wanna address some issues and complaints - many of them are already fixed for the full version of the game. Here's the list:

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

1. Gamepad issue - can't use keyboard / mouse with a gamepad connected, or even without one
Status: Fixed. You can now switch between the gamepad and K&M on the fly by using either one.

2. Stolen loot amount not displayed
Status: Fixed

3. NPC tracking not working after learning 'Perception' skill
Status: Fixed

[h3]Improvements and other changes[/h3]

1. Reader skill now also provides a 10% experience gain bonus
2. Window shutters can be opened individually if you have the 'Hackerman Level 2' skill
3. You can now fight with your fists (and some NPCs can too)
4. Spawn point in Lakeside St. moved away from houses
5. Opening doors doesn't alert the police immidiately to your location anymore
6. Friendly fire enabled
7. Banana issue fixed
8. Many minor issues and bugs were fixed


We're less than a month from release which is exciting news ːsteamhappyː

As we get even closer to release, I will share more news and some comparsions between the full game and the demo.

notes.title: Demo update, abilities, clothes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I wanted to make a small update on the demo and also show some new stuff.

As for the demo, the game itself is finished but we're waiting for 3 things: new banner, new trailer and translations for the game. Hopefully we will be able to release it in February.

As for the full game, the development is going very good. If all goes according to plan and I don't get hit by a car, there's about 80% chance the game will release this year. The price will also be way lower than Thief Simulator 2.

Time to show some new stuff.

[h1]Abilities[/h1]

Once you reach New game +1, you will unlock ability vouchers, as well as the voucher machine, which must be purchased at your computer.

Currently you receive ability vouchers for completing quotas. There are 4 abilities in total, each one provides a different kind of a bonus - for example, you can call off a policeman if things get too heated, but only once per game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/453f366a9cb7c2d33d7f493ceaaf073ef30ec8dd.gif[/img]


[h1]Voucher machine[/h1]

Aside from unlocking abilities, you may also receive gift vouchers for playing the game. They can grant you random rewards, like new golden cards, tools, loot and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/e9f7b3ebb2149af64deaebcbe0ca822e3a87a83d.gif[/img]


[h1]Clothing[/h1]

Now you can order a cloth closet on the computer and change your looks. It's a bit more modular than the prologue, instead of changing the whole player model, you can change parts of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/ed49a00c9d4e8ab3e0cc47d0395b62717f71d646.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/7992b626ce79f4bece5c239f1a5671e9c3d9f87b.jpg[/img]


[h1]Throwing weapons[/h1]

I was unsure about the comeback of this mechanic since so many things have changed, but ultimately it's back. 

You can throw your crowbars and baseballs at people, knocking them out pretty good.

You can also throw them at your friends if you don't like them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/531afc8968f7e99e72c55fdbcfc7dc0dfb942e14.gif[/img]


For now that's it - if things keep moving as they are, we're gonna see a full release this year. ːsteamthisː

I hope you’re having a wonderful Christmas and enjoying the holiday season!

I’ve got some exciting news for those of you eagerly awaiting this game: the demo is ready and will be available soon—likely before the end of January! The demo will include one location with five buildings you can break into and rob. Even better, you can team up with a friend for some co-op fun.

[b]So, what’s this game all about?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/53f0684f13f76ae005009768dbfb9bd8531c5ebf.jpg[/img]

You start the game in prison for... well, let’s just say it’s not your proudest moment. Suddenly, someone offers to bail you out. The catch? They expect you to repay the favor—by working for them. Do you accept the deal?

Let’s say you take it. You’re given a pretty sweet hideout to “live” in. But there’s a big problem: debt. A mountain of it. And if you don’t pay up on time, well, let’s just say it won’t end well for you.

What do you do? You stick to what you know best: crime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/70cb977af58103c2dd0a4282b7a79b88d89359f9.gif[/img]

You’ll take on various jobs, complete challenges for cash, fulfill item requests, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/d732da48226522788fe1bb2d8235c72a777b79b5.gif[/img]

When you order fancy new tools, make sure you don’t accidentally stand in their way! Once you’re geared up, the next step is picking a target and preparing for the heist—preferably under the cover of night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/112eb48b837eb92e01cd94faf36580cafb504ab4.gif[/img]

Before you strike, it’s smart to scope out the location. If you skip this step, things can go south fast. And when they do, you’d better hide.

People have different routines—some sleep, some stroll outside, and others stay up late. Some might be armed, depending on the difficulty you choose, but most are harmless.

Planning is everything. If payment is due tomorrow, you can risk going in blind and hope for the best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/3ce513ad3da552b7344c3965d6689c6f7449cba5.gif[/img]

If things go completely sideways, you’ll retreat to your hideout. But beware: a day will pass, and it could mean the end of your run. Don’t worry, though! Each attempt unlocks something permanent that will give you an edge in your next try.

Currently, the game is about 25% complete. If all goes well, a full release might happen next year.

notes.title: Crime Simulator shenanigans
notes.notes:
Good day, Mr. Wick. It's been a while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/9df18dc7ffa693c2422e46867e8fe38c1099a789.png[/img]
But seriously, progress is good. Almost half way done with the demo. First map is nearly finished, there are 7 houses and one huge garage to rob - the demo will feature about 4 houses.

[b]New store design with user reviews[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/aa3cde12164bd4209500b0400ecd15d6869db543.png[/img]
Reviews aren't really necessary but they provide some slight context for what the item can be used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/cbf6c4b8c37e83f96031979eb6e66c385b08e579.png[/img]

notes.title: Crime Simulator Devlog - Tools showcase
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, today I want to showcase all sorts of items and tools which will be available for the player to buy and use how he sees fit.

[h1]1. Drone[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011589/72ad8b64388f09578269dbeec0153e727d3dab50.png[/img]
You can use the drone to scope out an area, and also install upgrades which can make it possible to, let's say, hack a security camera / panel, or make a noise which alerts NPCs.

[h1]2. Thermal vision goggles[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011589/53d9851feb4d5b95ec103d2b6959dccac817f9d2.png[/img]
These can be used to see NPCs through walls, as well as other players.

[h1]3. Blowtorch[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011589/e9c7ed60256c64448477324b43c543f9f851caa2.png[/img]
Can be used to break into some metal locks, like the safe.

[h1]4. Scanner[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011589/bc0633cdc11b521b79a7ce1790fa771f404f45a0.png[/img]
Can be used to scan for certain items, like money, notes and more. Upgrades can be found and installed which allow for more items to be scanned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011589/8c42a2bb35fc9f06c2f448d7b72d2cdc8c18efc3.png[/img]
Three types of darts - sleep dart, diversion dart and hack dart. Each does a different thing when shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011589/835f675be646df9af2632d88ccaa878cba4da629.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011589/cfb39851cbfc0358e51ff9384497ac8c7c8e1dcc.png[/img]

notes.title: I make game
notes.notes:
Like the title

But seriously, there's some nice progress going on. I've made some nice minigames, trying to upgrade them from TS2, to make them less annoying and time consuming. 

[b]1. Computer, apps and radar[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/115438855835671fc893e2b083a01caf255afae6.jpg[/img]
When you start up your session in let's say, Neighbourhood nr 1, you will have a small container-like area where you can bring in loot and take it back home. You will receive a computer with certain apps, like Jobs, Item lists (completing them grants bonuses) etc.

Also you will be able to check your stats, learned skills, and buy a radar which shows all players and interesting things on the map.

[b]2. Skill system[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/cfc60609f9da8e6d600d53a8873be5f11a83da5a.jpg[/img]
Once you level up, you can spend a skill point. To do that however, you need to find or buy a skill magazine, like the one above. Each magazine grants different skills, obviously. This one above makes it possible to lockpick simple locks.

[b]3. Minigames, part one[/b]

[i]Padlock[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/cc6e0b71071c6c965ef65501e5adf8c9ebc409be.jpg[/img]
You can either find the code in the nearby area (a note, a writing on a wall etc.) or just blow it up with a mini-bomb or use the crowbar. That however, will alert nearby NPCs.

[i]Safe cracking[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/a850b3b5639a6b2eae06f2564882ca530aa6e33c.jpg[/img]
Safe cracking will be similiar to TS2, albeit quicker to complete, and you have the option to enter the code without using a stethoscope (if you know the code).

[i]Window cutting[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/00e132032ed294049caf2f64e2fcd09afa4dbff4.jpg[/img]
Window cutting will be completely different though - you have to cut edges of the glass with a special knife.

All in all, it's going well. Stay tuned for more ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Crime Simulator Devlog #1 - Back to basics
notes.notes:
Hi, I'd like to share some progress I made on Crime Sim over the past week - I'd say it's looking far more promising than whatever was in the prologue.

I've been working mostly on the UI, player animations and inventory. I'm going with the Slots inventory style - you get 5 slots for items, and can expand that with upgrades up to 9 slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/dfac66f127a1b757f02bd1e0f651abf3c03690d9.png[/img]
I think the UI is kinda nice, I tried to make it as clean as possible, without needless obstructions.

Other than that, I've made progress with player animations and the overall feel of movement. 
To your delight, you will have legs visible in first person view! Just like in TS2 - for immersion purposes, and if someone likes legs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/8dbb801ea7e2847807b43df257a764357eb7098d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/87bb232ff22070fda4a2ad34bb823497702d9023.png[/img]
So far I rate the development process a 8/10 - I've not lost my mind yet.

Make sure to follow the game for any future devlogs! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Crime Simulator will be fully remade
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

first of all, I want to thank everyone for participating in the prologue, reporting all bugs and feedback, as well as completing the survey. Your help is most important in the process of making this game a better, and a more fun experience.

I want to announce I will be remaking Crime Simulator fully, from ground up, considering all feedback. I want to make sure the full release will be a good experience for players all around the globe.

Main points I will be adressing while working on the project:
[olist]
[*] We will be moving to a new, up-to-date multiplayer solution (Photon Fusion)
[*] The gameplay loop will be completely remade, inspired slightly by Lethal Company
[*] The player will receive his own hideout which can be decorated / furnished
[*] Improving the movement / fluidity of gameplay
[*] Improved stealth system / more emphasis on stealth gameplay
[*] Larger locations with more varied loot to steal
[*] Improving the networking and region solutions
[/olist]
[h1]Playtests and demo[/h1]
As soon as we have something playable, we will be rolling out a playtest for all users for free, in order to check the state of networking, and gather all reports on bugs. 

Once we have that and all is well, as far as bugs and networking is concerned, the game will receive new screenshots, a better banner and a 30 minute demo (possibly with co-op).

[h1]Devlogs[/h1]

I will try to upload devlogs about the progress at least once a month / two months - I'd like gamers to participate in the whole process right from the start, until the end. After all, happy gamers is what I want the most.

Here's a small ragdoll mechanic sneak peak - I'm making it possible to trigger your own ragdoll at any time (for fun), but also for dying purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011603/18599c0f530315b90c7a625530ae7a2dc9a63cdc.gif[/img]

[h1]Full release[/h1]

Full release might take a while - I want to make sure the game is as good as it can be before indicating any release date. We will gather all the feedback from the upcoming playtests and the demo in order to make the full game great. We all have to be patient though ːsteamhappyː
